notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.notes:
Fix/Edit:

- Reduced wear on all tools by 100% (old value 5% durability per hit, new 2.5% per hit)
- Increased damage to melee weapons
- Game file size reduced by 50% (500mb)
- Fixed issues with saving character statistics
- Fixed problems with collisions of buildings that could not be entered because of this
- Fixed the problem when the game did not update without reinstallation
- Fixed some other errors

(PLS) Reinstall the game for those who didn't get the automatic update.

notes.title: Update 0.2.8
notes.notes:
Added:

- More ways to climb onto rooftops.

Fix/Edit:

- A few minor errors.
- Improved online connections.
- Game performance has been slightly improved.

We listen to players, so all your suggestions will be added and corrected in order of priority.

(Pls If there is no update 0.2.8, then reinstall the game)
